name: Haha Urara
source: The protagonist comes back for summer to his hometown, meets his childhood friends who are in a relationship but the girl still has feelings for him. Also he helps out his mother in her cafeteria where she usually also receives visits from a local supplier of alcohol. Will he protect his mother and his feelings for her or will he try to connect with his childhood love interest?
translation: 主人公趁着暑假回到故乡小镇，与已成情侣的青梅竹马们重逢——然而其中的女孩心里依然对他怀有情愫。与此同时，他还在母亲经营的食堂里帮忙打下手，而当地的一名酒水供应商平时常来店里拜访母亲。他究竟会守护母亲并正视自己对她的感情，还是会试着与青梅竹马的初恋再续前缘？
